subject.title: BL-ecommerce-coupons-27: coupon validation trusts client-sent shipping cost and regional surplus

question: Should coupon prevalidation get a standalone server-side shipping recalculation patch now, or should it be implemented together with the broader checkout amount trust-boundary work?
rationale: Both issues depend on the same shipping-cost source of truth; choosing the sequencing and endpoint ownership is a maintainer security and domain-boundary decision, not a small mechanical cleanup.

options.title: Share one shipping service across both fixes
options.body: Build the server-side shipping calculation once and apply it to coupon prevalidation and checkout amount validation so the two trust boundaries cannot drift.

options.title: Patch coupon prevalidation first
options.body: Keep the endpoint in admin for now and make the narrow coupon route stop accepting client amounts, accepting the risk of a near-term second shipping calculation for checkout.

options.title: Wait for the BL coupon block
options.body: Sequence this behind the Coupons & Promotions BL validation work, reducing churn but leaving the prevalidation trust gap open longer.

recommendation.title: Share one shipping service across both fixes
recommendation.body: Build the server-side shipping calculation once and apply it to coupon prevalidation and checkout amount validation so the two trust boundaries cannot drift.

likelyOwner.reason: MiguelHamelyn is named as Coupons & Promotions owner and has recent checkout-area history, making him the best available owner for sequencing coupon and checkout fixes.
